records.failureSummary:
Strengthened the AC-numbered test suite in test/persist.test.mjs (temp dirs/temp files, no external services) and produced genuine red-first evidence without modifying product code.

RED PHASE: using only the allowed sandbox test tool, I swapped src/persist.mjs and src/store.mjs for the pre-implementation HEAD placeholders (loadData/saveData throw "尚未实现", store.toJSON throws) and ran node --test test/persist.test.mjs -> exit 1, 11/11 failing (not ok 1..11 for AC-01..AC-09). The real files were then restored byte-for-byte (verified with cmp = YES) and the green run gave 11/11 pass.

GREEN PHASE: full npm test = 19 tests, 19 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors. npm run build and npm run lint both exit 0.

Coverage now maps 1:1 to the acceptance criteria, every test name carries its AC id: [AC-01] loadData missing file (fresh default each call, no shared mutable default), [AC-02] invalid JSON, [AC-03] invalid structure (10 malformed shapes incl. [], null, 42, string, {}, items:{}, nextId as string/null, missing fields), [AC-04] valid data returned as-is, [AC-05] nested parent dirs created recursively, [AC-06] write->loadData round-trip equal to JSON.stringify(data) with only the target file left in the dir, [AC-06] atomic replace of an existing target with no temp leftover, [AC-07] rename failure keeps target intact (non-empty dir sentinel survives), temp file cleaned up, error propagates with a code, [AC-08] fromJSON(toJSON()) preserves observable state and exact {items,nextId} shape, [AC-08] round-trip consistency between store shape and on-disk file shape, [AC-09] fromJSON accepts the loadData fallback {items:[],nextId:1}. The pre-existing test/store.test.mjs is left untouched.

No product code was changed by this task: git diff for src/ is identical to the upstream T3/T4/T5 state, and no stray files remain in the workspace.
